summary: Skier caught in a wind-slab avalanche in the San Juan Mountains near Silverton, swept an estimated 500 feet down the mountainside and partially buried before a ski partner dug him out; the skier was unharmed and the party self-evacuated
notes: Freshness sweep 2026-11-18: Outside Online 2026-11-06 + POWDER 2026-11-04, both reporting the Nov 3 video by pro skier/filmmaker Colter Hinchliffe; skier's name and age unreported; CAIC has not published this as an official accident report (only the Oct 25 Mt. Bross accident is officially documented this season per CAIC via Outside, Nov 6).
